name: Borigaon

routes.httpStatus: Discovery result available; official Assam government PDF
routes.outcome: Lists Borigaon under Udalguri Revenue Circle and identifies the local village/land-record administrative context. No parcel geometry was extracted.

Current Dharitree citizen page rendered district selection and included Udalguri with district code 27. The page requires district/circle/village selection and CAPTCHA for record lookup; no login or CAPTCHA attempt was made.
Followed the official JavaScript to POST getCirdivJson, getVillCodeJson and searchVillage routes. These are record-navigation routes, not a public parcel-geometry API.
Anonymous request with district_code=27 returned an empty JSON array. No circle or village identity/geometry response was obtained.
Official Bhunaksha cadastral mapping viewer loaded and exposed current JavaScript configuration.

Current viewer configuration exposes backend routes for districts, circles, villages, WMS capabilities, parcel_info, click_info and GeoJSON-like geometry responses. The source uses ASSAM_PARCEL and EPSG:32646 for parcel geometry operations.
Current public district list returned 24 districts but omitted Udalguri; therefore no supported current village-code route for Borigaon was available from this viewer.
Viewer issued a short-lived public session auth token as part of its normal anonymous page flow. It was not retained in the packet and was not used to request unsafe fields.
Initial guessed API prefix rejected the request; the official JavaScript showed the correct backend prefix. No bypass or credential use was attempted.
